# SKIE

When SKIE is present, KMP Lens treats it as an optional knowledge family. In the
exact qualified configuration, supported suspend-wrapper forms are displayed as
**Generated by SKIE**.

This label identifies the generator of the exact Apple form. It does not assign
an application Origin, Maven component, dependency path or Kotlin source to the
generated form.

Other SKIE versions, targets or structures remain **Unverified / best effort**.
KMP Lens continues with independently available Kotlin/Native, Gradle and source
knowledge. Complete declaration-by-declaration Swift semantics remain outside
KMP Lens 0.1.

See [Generated symbols]({{ '/generated-symbols/' | relative_url }}) and
[Compatibility]({{ '/compatibility/' | relative_url }}).
